title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation/Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
scientific_focus: Low-temperature flame transition; extinction and oxygen effects
project_setting: Ground Investigation; modeling and controlled flame studies
objectives: Characterize how oxygen concentration, stretch and radiative heat transfer shift cool-flame stability and extinction boundaries.
approach: Use FLEX flight conditions as a benchmark and compare three simulation methods: spark-assisted propagation in n-heptane/air, one-dimensional dimethyl ether flame propagation with arc-length continuation, and elevated-pressure dimethyl ether/air cool-flame computations up to approximately 20 atm.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
